title: Neurotic
subtitle: Lightning, speed, nerves
text: Neurotic tendency is nervous energy and crackling motion. Blood charged with nervous energy becomes unstable and fast. It seeks discharge. It cannot remain still for long without finding a direction to move in. Neurotic-tended practitioners often describe their blood as impatient — a constant pressure to act before thinking, to move before the moment passes. Some find this exhilarating. Others find it exhausting.
